recap.text: Donut's boss-fight boxes are mostly the same old crap, but a Silver Survivor's Box, for ending the fight with less than five percent of her health, gives her a dozen Heal scrolls. Carl's Bronze Survivor's Box, for having less than ten percent health when the boss died, adds five, making seventeen. There is no countdown between one scroll and the next, and they can be read on each other.

Street urchins skewer Donut, so Carl reads a Heal scroll on her, and the spikes squeeze out and scatter on the floor like pine needles. A second scroll on Mongo does nothing. When the Divider's corpse blows Carl onto a roof, Donut kills the last three monsters, two with magic missiles and one with Mongo, then leaps over and heals him with a scroll. He stays unconscious three more minutes, then wakes staring at the sky, a level higher.

When the train runs into the ghouls, gore blasts into the engine like a firehose, and Katia drops unconscious at half health with something shocking her. Carl, who has eight healing scrolls to Donut's six, reads one on her and her health returns to the top, but it keeps dropping. At ten percent he slams another, and with no debuff showing he reads another, then another. He will soon be out.

Donut, astride Mongo, walks up to Firas and reads one of their precious healing scrolls on him after a rocket blows everything back across the room. Louis is left screaming, burned and full of shrapnel, and Firas lies unconscious but otherwise whole. Carl drops one of his last hobgoblin smoke curtains at his feet, and says to get out of here.

Donut lies rigid beside Carl after the goddess's visit, unable to move, her health draining and her title changed from Warlord to Champion. Carl tries a healing scroll at once, but it misfires, so he waits while thousands of bodies fly up toward them from the broken ball outside. When Donut coughs, he slams on the scroll, and her health starts to rocket up.

Carl meets the eyes of Grigori, the psychotic AI standing on Lamashtu the donkey as the parade passes. Chaco lies at Grigori's feet with his health still in the red. Without looking away, Carl pulls up a healing scroll, selects Chaco and heals him, and Grigori does not react. Carl then points at the effigy of the Unwashed and speaks to the galaxy.

beats.headline: A dozen for nearly dying
beats.text: After the boss fight, Donut's boxes are mostly the same old crap, with a couple of exceptions. A Silver Survivor's Box, awarded for ending a boss battle with less than five percent of her health, gives her a dozen Heal scrolls. They are good to have: there is no countdown between reading one and the next, and even better, they can use them on each other. Those twelve are good, Mordecai says, and he suspects they are about to get a few more. Carl's own Bronze Survivor's Box, for having less than ten percent health when the boss died, brings five more, seventeen in all.
beats.gist: Donut's Silver Survivor's Box gives her twelve Heal scrolls, and Carl's Bronze box adds five, seventeen total.

beats.headline: Not on Mongo
beats.text: Street urchins are attacking Mongo and Donut because of the wood and metal Carl stacked round the cat, and Donut is getting skewered. Carl reads a Heal scroll, one of those from the Survivor's Box, focusing on her. She glows, and the spikes squeeze out of her body and scatter on the floor like pine needles. He tries a second on Mongo, and it doesn't work. He can't use a potion on the pet either. Hang in there, buddy.
beats.gist: Donut is skewered by street urchins; Carl's Heal scroll expels the spikes, but a second on Mongo fails.

beats.headline: Onto the roof
beats.text: The Divider's corpse blows and throws Carl onto a roof across the street. Donut grabs the neighborhood map, leaps out of the pool and finishes off the last three monsters, two with magic missiles and the third with Mongo. Then she leaps to the roof where Carl landed and uses a heal scroll to bring his health back up. He stays unconscious for another three minutes despite being healed, and wakes staring at the sky, a level higher.
beats.gist: Donut uses a heal scroll on the unconscious Carl on a roof; he wakes a level higher.

beats.headline: Topping off Katia
beats.text: Carl has eight scrolls of healing ready and Donut another six when the train runs into the ghouls. Gore blasts into the engine like a firehose, and Katia, who has been fine, is suddenly unconscious at half health and dropping: something is shocking her. Where the hell is that healer? Carl casts his heal scroll on Katia and her health returns to the top, though she stays unconscious and it keeps dropping. At ten percent he slams another to top her off, and when her health keeps dwindling with no debuff showing, he reads another, then another. He will soon be out.
beats.gist: Carl heals Katia with scroll after scroll as she stays unconscious and her health keeps dropping.

beats.headline: One of the precious ones
beats.text: A rocket blows everything back across the room. Louis is screaming, burned and full of shrapnel. Firas has been blown across the room and is unconscious, but otherwise looks okay. Donut, astride Mongo, both unharmed at the back of the room, goes to Firas and uses one of their precious healing scrolls on him. Carl drops one of his last hobgoblin smoke curtains at his feet. Let's get out of here.
beats.gist: Donut heals unconscious Firas with a scroll; Carl drops a hobgoblin smoke curtain.

beats.headline: Misfire, then up
beats.text: Everything unfreezes after the goddess's visit, and beside Carl, Donut has gone rigid, unable to move, her health draining slowly, her title changed from Warlord to Champion. He tries to apply a healing scroll at once, but it misfires, and he has to wait. Outside, the ball has broken apart and thousands of bodies are flying up toward them. When Donut coughs, he slams on the healing scroll, and her health starts to rocket up.
beats.gist: Donut freezes and drains health; Carl's healing scroll misfires, then works when she coughs.

beats.headline: Healing Chaco
beats.text: The parade passes Lamashtu the donkey with Grigori standing on her, and Carl meets the psychotic AI's eyes. Chaco is at Grigori's feet, his health still in the red. Never taking his eyes off Grigori's, Carl pulls up a healing scroll, selects Chaco and heals him. Grigori's eyes never leave his own, and he does not react. Then Carl points at the effigy of the Unwashed and speaks to the galaxy.
beats.gist: Carl heals Chaco, who is still in the red, with a scroll while staring Grigori down.
